import csv, hashlib, importlib.util, json, shlex, subprocess
from pathlib import Path
root=Path.cwd()
p=root/'docs/plans/2026-11-02-cordis-completion/evidence/B0/matrix'
spec=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('docs_check',root/'tests/docs/check.py')
module=importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
spec.loader.exec_module(module)
module.links(p/'report.md')
print('Report local links/anchors: passed')
commands=json.loads((p/'commands.json').read_text())
rows=list(csv.DictReader((p/'commands.tsv').open(),delimiter='	'))
assert len(commands)==len(rows)==53
for command,row in zip(commands,rows):
 assert row['command']==shlex.join(command['argv'])
 assert json.loads(row['environment'])==command['environment']
 for key in ['id','cwd','start_utc','end_utc','exit_code','log']:
  assert row[key]==str(command[key]),(command['id'],key)
 text=(p/command['log']).read_text()
 for key,label in [('cwd','CWD'),('start_utc','START_UTC'),('end_utc','END_UTC'),('exit_code','EXIT_CODE')]:
  assert label+': '+str(command[key]) in text,(command['id'],label)
 assert 'COMMAND: '+shlex.join(command['argv']) in text
 assert command['exit_code']==0
required={tc+'-'+suffix for tc in ['stable','1.85.0'] for suffix in ['workspace-check','workspace-test','workspace-clippy','workspace-doc','m0-test','m0-clippy','example-lifecycle','example-timer_lifecycle']}
required.update(['stable-workspace-fmt','stable-m0-fmt','docs-regressions','docs-stable','docs-1.85.0','parity'])
assert len(required)==22 and required.issubset({c['id'] for c in commands})
print('53 JSON/TSV rows and full log metadata match; all 22 required IDs present; indexed exits: 0')
snapshots=[json.loads((p/name).read_text()) for name in ['before.json','after.json','after-supplement.json']]
inputs=snapshots[0]['executable_input_sha256']
assert len(inputs)==71
for snapshot in snapshots:
 assert snapshot['executable_input_sha256']==inputs
 assert snapshot['ts_head']=='35fdc969e4b6c48c48ed44717c7a018324e4dd88'
 assert not snapshot['ts_tracked_status'] and not snapshot['fixture_exists'] and not snapshot['executable_delta_since_808c9f5']
 assert snapshot['untracked_upstream_yarn_lock']==snapshots[0]['untracked_upstream_yarn_lock']
for name,digest in inputs.items():
 assert hashlib.sha256((root/name).read_bytes()).hexdigest()==digest,name
changes=subprocess.check_output(['git','diff','--name-only',snapshots[0]['head'],snapshots[1]['head']],text=True).splitlines()
assert changes==['docs/plans/2026-11-02-cordis-completion/progress.md'],changes
print('All 71 recorded executable inputs match snapshots and current bytes; tested revision diff contains progress.md only')
meta=json.loads((p/'summarize-validation-2026-11-02.json').read_text())
assert meta['exit_code']==0 and meta['preserved_bytes_unchanged']
assert meta['preserved_sha256_before']==meta['preserved_sha256_after']
for name,digest in meta['preserved_sha256_after'].items():
 assert hashlib.sha256((p/name).read_bytes()).hexdigest()==digest,name
print('Summary exit: 0; results/script/original attempt bytes remain unchanged')
subprocess.run(['git','diff','--check'],check=True)
print('git diff --check: passed')
